title: pvTemporalCacheSource
body:
## pvTemporalCacheSource

The same cache as pvTemporalCache (vtkTemporalDataSetCache), registered by ParaView as a source with IsASource true, the configuration meant for Catalyst in-situ pipelines: it then reports only the times currently held in the cache as its time steps and keeps entries even when the upstream pipeline changes, so it can hold a short history of a live simulation. For post-processing stored results use pvTemporalCache.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Because entries are not invalidated when upstream settings change, results can be stale; use pvTemporalCache in ordinary pipelines.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TemporalCacheSource`. Identity: `sources/TemporalCache`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the Temporal Cache filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CacheSize` | The cache size determines the number of time steps that can be cached at one time. The maximum number is 10. The minimum is 2 (since it makes little sense to cache less than that). | `{"maximum":10,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |
| `IsASource` | Sets up the Algorithm to act as a pipeline source rather than a filter. This is used in Catalyst. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTemporalCacheSource",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
